verdict.rationale: A government e-filing portal could plausibly offer versioned APIs, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only web-portal features for the Guichet unique: dashboards, document filing, payment and signing. It contains nothing about API versioning or a deprecation policy. The keyless API probe hit the separate recherche-entreprises state API, not the Guichet unique, so it cannot be credited to this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
